# Plan: Geo-tiered CTA mode toggle

## Summary
Add a `ctaMode` settings flag (`default` | `buy-only` | `trial-only`) that can be set per geo/locale in Studio and delivered via MAS-IO settings. When the flag is active, `hydrate.js` suppresses the non-active CTA type at render time before the card is attached to the DOM — no card fragment content is modified.

## Task Description
Implement a settings-based CTA mode toggle across three domains: (1) register `ctaMode` as a known setting in MAS-IO so it is included in the settings payload, (2) add swap logic in `hydrate.js` that reads `settings.ctaMode` and suppresses the conflicting CTA type from the rendered card, including a Learn More fallback for unpaired single-CTA placements, and (3) add `ctaMode` to the Studio settings name map so admin can author and preview the flag.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js` | Edit | Add `ctaMode` to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` so it is recognised and delivered via the settings pipeline |
| `web-components/src/hydrate.js` | Edit | Add `processCtaMode()` function and call it from `hydrate()` after `processCTAs()` |
| `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js` | Edit | Re-exports `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE`; the new entry in `settings.js` is auto-included, but verify `getSettingDefaultValue` handles `select` editor type |
| `web-components/test/hydrate.test.js` | Edit | Add unit tests for `processCtaMode` |
| `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.test.js` | Edit | Add test asserting `ctaMode` is extracted and propagated as a text setting |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Register `ctaMode` in SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS
- In `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js`, add to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS`:
  ```js
  { name: 'ctaMode', valueType: 'text', editor: 'select' },
  ```
- This makes `extractValue` return the `textValue` (`default`, `buy-only`, or `trial-only`) and `applySettings` writes it to `fragment.settings.ctaMode`
- No other changes needed in the IO pipeline — locale-override resolution already works for `text` type

### 2. Add `getSettingDefaultValue` support for `select` editor
- In `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js`, add a branch in `getSettingDefaultValue`:
  ```js
  if (definition.editor === 'select') return 'default';
  ```
- This prevents the Studio UI from rendering an undefined default for the new select-type setting

### 3. Implement `processCtaMode` in hydrate.js

**CTA type detection** — a CTA element is a trial CTA if it has `data-modal="twp"` on itself or on its inner `checkout-button`/`checkout-link`; otherwise it is a buy CTA.

Add to `web-components/src/hydrate.js`:
```js
export function processCtaMode(fields, merchCard, settings) {
    const ctaMode = settings?.ctaMode;
    if (!ctaMode || ctaMode === 'default') return;

    const footer = merchCard.querySelector('[slot]'); // CTA footer slot
    if (!footer) return;
    const allCtas = [...footer.querySelectorAll('a, checkout-button, checkout-link, sp-button')];
    if (!allCtas.length) return;

    const isTrialCta = (el) =>
        el.dataset?.modal === 'twp' ||
        el.getAttribute('data-modal') === 'twp';

    const suppressMode = ctaMode === 'buy-only' ? 'trial' : 'buy'; // which type to remove

    const toSuppress = allCtas.filter((el) =>
        suppressMode === 'trial' ? isTrialCta(el) : !isTrialCta(el),
    );
    const toKeep = allCtas.filter((el) =>
        suppressMode === 'trial' ? !isTrialCta(el) : isTrialCta(el),
    );

    if (toKeep.length > 0) {
        // Fully remove suppressed CTAs from DOM
        toSuppress.forEach((el) => el.remove());
    } else {
        // All CTAs are the suppressed type — replace with Learn More fallback
        const learnMoreUrl = fields?.learnMoreUrl || '#';
        const learnMoreLabel = fields?.learnMoreLabel || 'Learn More';
        const fallback = createTag('a', { href: learnMoreUrl, class: 'learn-more-fallback' }, learnMoreLabel);
        footer.innerHTML = '';
        footer.append(fallback);
    }
}
```

### 4. Wire `processCtaMode` into `hydrate()`
- In the `hydrate()` function in `hydrate.js`, after the `processCTAs(...)` call, add:
  ```js
  processCtaMode(fields, merchCard, settings);
  ```
- `settings` is already destructured from `fragment` at the top of `hydrate()`

### 5. Add unit tests for `processCtaMode`
- In `web-components/test/hydrate.test.js`:
  - `buy-only` with dual CTAs: only trial CTA removed, buy CTA retained
  - `trial-only` with dual CTAs: only buy CTA removed, trial CTA retained
  - `buy-only` with single trial-only CTA: replaced by Learn More link
  - `trial-only` with single buy-only CTA: replaced by Learn More link

# Plan: Geo-tiered CTA mode toggle

## Summary
Add a `ctaMode` settings flag (`default` | `buy-only` | `trial-only`) that can be set per geo/locale in Studio and delivered via MAS-IO settings. When the flag is active, `hydrate.js` suppresses the non-active CTA type at render time before the card is attached to the DOM — no card fragment content is modified.

## Task Description
Implement a settings-based CTA mode toggle across three domains: (1) register `ctaMode` as a known setting in MAS-IO so it is included in the settings payload, (2) add swap logic in `hydrate.js` that reads `settings.ctaMode` and suppresses the conflicting CTA type from the rendered card, including a Learn More fallback for unpaired single-CTA placements, and (3) add `ctaMode` to the Studio settings name map so admin can author and preview the flag.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js` | Edit | Add `ctaMode` to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` so it is recognised and delivered via the settings pipeline |
| `web-components/src/hydrate.js` | Edit | Add `processCtaMode()` function and call it from `hydrate()` after `processCTAs()` |
| `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js` | Edit | Re-exports `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE`; the new entry in `settings.js` is auto-included, but verify `getSettingDefaultValue` handles `select` editor type |

| `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.test.js` | Edit | Add test asserting `ctaMode` is extracted and propagated as a text setting |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Register `ctaMode` in SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS
- In `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js`, add to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS`:
  ```js
  { name: 'ctaMode', valueType: 'text', editor: 'select' },
  ```
- This makes `extractValue` return the `textValue` (`default`, `buy-only`, or `trial-only`) and `applySettings` writes it to `fragment.settings.ctaMode`
- No other changes needed in the IO pipeline — locale-override resolution already works for `text` type

### 2. Add `getSettingDefaultValue` support for `select` editor
- In `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js`, add a branch in `getSettingDefaultValue`:
  ```js
  if (definition.editor === 'select') return 'default';
  ```
- This prevents the Studio UI from rendering an undefined default for the new select-type setting

### 3. Implement `processCtaMode` in hydrate.js

**CTA type detection** — a CTA element is a trial CTA if it has `data-modal="twp"` on itself or on its inner `checkout-button`/`checkout-link`; otherwise it is a buy CTA.

Add to `web-components/src/hydrate.js`:
```js
export function processCtaMode(fields, merchCard, settings) {
    const ctaMode = settings?.ctaMode;
    if (!ctaMode || ctaMode === 'default') return;

    const footer = merchCard.querySelector('[slot]'); // CTA footer slot
    if (!footer) return;
    const allCtas = [...footer.querySelectorAll('a, checkout-button, checkout-link, sp-button')];
    if (!allCtas.length) return;

    const isTrialCta = (el) =>
        el.dataset?.modal === 'twp' ||
        el.getAttribute('data-modal') === 'twp';

    const suppressMode = ctaMode === 'buy-only' ? 'trial' : 'buy'; // which type to remove

    const toSuppress = allCtas.filter((el) =>
        suppressMode === 'trial' ? isTrialCta(el) : !isTrialCta(el),
    );
    const toKeep = allCtas.filter((el) =>
        suppressMode === 'trial' ? !isTrialCta(el) : isTrialCta(el),
    );

    if (toKeep.length > 0) {
        // Fully remove suppressed CTAs from DOM
        toSuppress.forEach((el) => el.remove());
    } else {
        // All CTAs are the suppressed type — replace with Learn More fallback
        const learnMoreUrl = fields?.learnMoreUrl || '#';
        const learnMoreLabel = fields?.learnMoreLabel || 'Learn More';
        const fallback = createTag('a', { href: learnMoreUrl, class: 'learn-more-fallback' }, learnMoreLabel);
        footer.innerHTML = '';
        footer.append(fallback);
    }
}
```

### 4. Wire `processCtaMode` into `hydrate()`
- In the `hydrate()` function in `hydrate.js`, after the `processCTAs(...)` call, add:
  ```js
  processCtaMode(fields, merchCard, settings);
  ```
- `settings` is already destructured from `fragment` at the top of `hydrate()`

### 5. Add unit tests for `processCtaMode`
- In `web-components/test/hydrate.test.js`:
  - `buy-only` with dual CTAs: only trial CTA removed, buy CTA retained
  - `trial-only` with dual CTAs: only buy CTA removed, trial CTA retained
  - `buy-only` with single trial-only CTA: replaced by Learn More link
  - `trial-only` with single buy-only CTA: replaced by Learn More link
  - `default` mode: no changes applied
  - No CTAs present: no error thrown

### 6. Add test for settings pipeline
- In `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.test.js` (or equivalent test file):
  - Assert that a settings fragment with `name: 'ctaMode'` and `textValue: 'buy-only'` results in `fragment.settings.ctaMode === 'buy-only'`
  - Assert locale override for ctaMode resolves correctly for a matching locale

- When `ctaMode=buy-only`, all elements with `data-modal="twp"` in the CTA footer are removed from the DOM before the card is shown
- When `ctaMode=trial-only`, all non-trial CTA elements in the footer are removed from the DOM
- When only the suppressed CTA type is present and `learnMoreUrl` is set in fields, a plain anchor fallback is rendered in place
- When `ctaMode=default` or is absent, no CTA changes are made
- No empty `[slot]` containers are left after swap (CTAs removed, not hidden)
